narration: Their catamaran flipped eleven and a half miles off Hawaii, [short pause] and two men were in the water.
A Coast Guard Hercules plane and a Dolphin helicopter from Air Station Barbers Point found them beside the overturned hull.
The basket goes down on a steel cable. One man climbs in, [short pause] and the flight mechanic reels him up.
Then the cable goes back down for the second man.
outcome: Both men were hoisted safely and brought ashore to Kapolei.
title: Catamaran flipped 11 miles off Hawaii
description:
Two men ended up in the water after their 10-foot catamaran capsized about 11.5 miles off Haleiwa, Hawaii, on July 14, 2026. A Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules crew and an MH-65 Dolphin crew from Air Station Barbers Point found them, hoisted them and brought them ashore.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, Air Station Barbers Point, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1014806
